title: Robust perturbation evaluation for low-bit quantization and tuning playbook
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: build an end-to-end evaluation and tuning playbook that assesses the functional and semantic fidelity impact of low-bit quantization (int8/int4) across AWQ and GPTQ pipelines and produces per-model, per-workload threshold recommendations. The playbook must: 1) expose a reproducible perturbation suite (synthetic + production prompt cohorts) that stresses numeric and semantic failure modes; 2) compute multi-dimensional fidelity metrics (semantic divergence, token-level KL, task accuracy, hallucination rate) and map them to economic knobs (latency, memory, cost); 3) provide an autotuner that suggests safe quant thresholds and fallback gating rules for canary and rollout automation; 4) integrate with the regression-monitoring alerting pipeline so deployments automatically block or rollback on detected fidelity regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Perturbation suite repo with >=3 synthetic generators and ingestion adapters for 5 production prompt cohorts
Evaluation job that runs AWQ and GPTQ variants and emits a standardized CSV/Parquet with canonical metrics
Autotuner that recommends bitwidth and layer-exempt lists with a confidence score and expected latency delta
A runbook describing gating thresholds for canary/AB rollout and automated rollback conditions
Dashboard tile on Console showing per-route quant delta heatmap and alerting rule wired to PagerDuty

reproducibility_steps: Checkout repo: git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/quant-evals && cd quant-evals
Install runners: poetry install && pip install -r runners/requirements.txt
Prepare cohort CSVs in data/cohorts (search-assist.csv, chat-support.csv, summarization.csv)
Run: python harness/run_sweep.py --model small-gpt --runners awq,gptq --profiles int8,int4 --cohorts search-assist,chat-support
risks_and_mitigation: AWQ/GPTQ weight layout mismatches can silently produce skewed outputs -> mitigation: binary hash checks and small-sample functional tests before full-run
Synthetic generators may not reflect production prompt diversity -> mitigation: require a minimum of 5 production cohorts and compute cohort-weighted metrics
Autotuner overfitting to toy models -> mitigation: cross-validate recommendations across at least two model families before recommending rollout defaults
Alert storm risk when integrating to regression-monitoring -> mitigation: introduce a severity tier and a 1-hour aggregation window before PagerDuty escalation
